name: orion-api nightly scan
originalTriggers: schedule: cron 30 1 * * * (UTC) on main, always: true (runs even without changes)
no CI trigger, no pull request trigger

taskMap.github: run: dotnet sonarscanner begin (token and host from the SONAR_TOKEN secret and SONAR_HOST_URL variable)
taskMap.note: the service connection orion-sonarqube is replaced by that secret and variable
the scan metadata file path .sonarqube/out/.sonar/report-task.txt is the MSBuild scanner default and was not verified

acceptedWarnings.why: The source gives these jobs no environment and keeps the credentials at repository level (Azure variable groups are not environment-scoped). Scoping them to a GitHub environment is a hardening choice for the reviewer; it would add approvals and deployment records the source does not have.

notes: The nightly schedule is only recorded in originalTriggers: enabling it is a separate approval.
dotnet-sonarscanner is installed unpinned with dotnet tool install; pin it when the version is chosen.
